reader_summary.overview: I'm hoping to spread the word for what will be a fascinating new podcast hosted by my good friend, Ted Sides. The show is called Capital Allocators and will feature a wide range of people that control the flow of money through the capital markets. Ted is in a unique position to do this.

thesis: The episode introduces the Capital Allocators podcast, hosted by Ted Seides, which explores how leaders in capital markets allocate their time and money. The first guest, Steve Galbraith, shares his personal story of buying a European soccer team as a value investment, only to face unexpected relegation risks and financial losses despite the team's eventual promotion.
